title: Bunny dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='22' rx='7' ry='18' fill='#e8e4f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='24' rx='4' ry='13' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='20' rx='7' ry='18' fill='#e8e4f0' transform='rotate(15 64 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='4' ry='13' fill='#f0a8c0' transform='rotate(15 64 20)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#e8e4f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='13' ry='16' fill='#f7f5fb'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='17' fill='#e8e4f0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='3' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='3' fill='#5a4a7a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='37' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <path d='M50 47 q-3 4 -6 2 M50 47 q3 4 6 2' stroke='#c8a0b8' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='45' r='3' fill='#f7c8d8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='3' fill='#f7c8d8'/>
  <!-- dancing arm left (up) -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='55' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e8e4f0' transform='rotate(-40 27 55)'/>
  <!-- dancing arm right (up) -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='52' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#e8e4f0' transform='rotate(40 73 52)'/>
  <!-- legs kicking -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='88' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#e8e4f0' transform='rotate(-20 36 88)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='86' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#e8e4f0' transform='rotate(20 66 86)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='90' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='89' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0a8c0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='78' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M20 30 l2 4 4 2 -4 2 -2 4 -2 -4 -4 -2 4 -2 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <path d='M78 32 l1.5 3 3 1.5 -3 1.5 -1.5 3 -1.5 -3 -3 -1.5 3 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='70' r='2' fill='#8ad8ff'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='68' r='2' fill='#8ad8ff'/>
</svg>
